findings.description: runtime::tests is Unix-only; the dedicated Bazel qualification filter previously became empty on Windows. Current BUILD attaches Unix compatibility to qualification lib, test binary and wrapper; default unit target retains exact unsupported admission tests.

DurablePromptRegistry::prepare_directory and FinalUseAuthority store prepare_directory return exact UnsafeStateDirectory before writing on non-Unix. All gated integration fixtures require one of these owners. Pure runtime configuration tests remain cross-platform.

Windows helper requests read/write plus BACKUP_SEMANTICS; actual sync_all propagates errors. Ordinary NTFS directory probe agrees; it used OPEN_REPARSE_POINT which official CreateFile contract ignores for non-reparse objects. Existing follow behavior is retained and no anti-redirection guarantee is added.
